question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**interpersonal**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses emotional intelligence and its impact on relationships and communication.
 
• The missing word should relate to the benefits of emotional intelligence in interactions with others.
 
• "**Interpersonal**" fits well as it relates to relationships and social interactions, which aligns with the context of emotional intelligence.
 
• Other options ("**financial**", "**self-centred**", "**academic**") do not fit the context of emotional intelligence and relationship-building.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Financial (वित्तीय): "Financial" refers to money-related matters, which is unrelated to emotional intelligence.
 
• Self-centred (आत्मकेंद्रित): "Self-centred" means focused on oneself, which contradicts the idea of emotional intelligence.
 
• Academic (शैक्षिक): "Academic" relates to studies and education, which does not fit the context of relationships.
